description: Get the full assignment record for one assignment by ID, including every `include` extra requested. Get the assignment_id from list_assignments, which also supports fields="slim" for scanning many assignments before fetching one here in full. `include` adds submission (the current user's own), assignment_visibility, overrides, observed_users, can_edit, and score_statistics — each omitted from the response unless requested.

all_dates.description: Return all dates associated with this assignment

include.description: Extra fields to include on the assignment (Canvas include[] param)

override_assignment_dates.description: Apply assignment overrides to due/unlock/lock dates

name: get_assignment
title: Get Assignment
